rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING FOR THE PROTECTION OF WOMEN AND MINORS AGAINST DOMESTIC VIOLENCE, SEXUAL ASSAULT, EXPLOITATION AND OTHER FORMS OF ABUSE AND PRESCRIBING PENALTIES FOR VIOLATION THEREOF
rows.abstract: "Women and Minors Protection Law of 1992" States   what are considered "DOMESTIC VIOLENCE;" "SEXUAL ASSAULT;" AND "EXPLOITATION" as used in this Act. Provides   for the establishment of   a comprehensive sex education program for students; statesthe policies  to be followed during calamities  as far  as women and children are concerned. Prescribes the penalties for violations against the rights of women and minors. * * *
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on JUSTICE since 1992-12-10

rows.title_full: AN ACT GRANTING INCENTIVES TO AGENCIES PROVIDING CHILD CARE FACILITIES
rows.abstract: Applies  to private or government agencies, including government-owne d or-controlled institutions. Grants the following incentives: (1) exemption from payment of all forms of taxes; (2) to  charge costs  as expenses  for income  tax purposes. Specifies  the amenities referred to in this proposed measure. * * *
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on SOCIAL SERVICES since 1992-12-10
